#### Revised Financial Impact Model

The original opportunity estimated $1.5M–$2.88M in annual EBITDA impact. After validating Halden's actual financials, we present a more grounded, three-tier impact model based on the LTM September 2025 revenue of $26.2M and current EBITDA of $6.41M [30]:

| Impact Lever | Conservative | Moderate | Optimistic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Gross Margin Recovery** (pp improvement) | 3.0 pp | 4.0 pp | 5.0 pp |
| **GP Improvement** (on $26.2M revenue) | $785K | $1,050K | $1,310K |
| **Discount Leakage Reduction** | $17.2K | $28.7K | $38K |
| **Capacity Utilization Contribution** | $115K | $201K | $288K |
| **Total Annual Gross Profit Impact** | **$918K** | **$1,280K** | **$1,640K** |
| **Less: Implementation Amortized Cost** (Year 1) | ($144K) | ($144K) | ($144K) |
| **Net EBITDA Impact** | **$774K** | **$1,130K** | **$1,500K** |
| **EBITDA Margin Lift** (on $26.2M) | **+3.0 pp** | **+4.3 pp** | **+5.7 pp** |
| **Resulting EBITDA Margin** | ~27.4% | ~28.7% | ~30.1% |

## Risk Assessment

### Risk Matrix

| Risk | Severity | Probability | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Compound cost spike ($0.632→$0.885/lb) erases margin gains** | High | High | Automated escalation clauses in all quotes; Phase 1 priority |
| **Salesperson resistance to floor prices** | Medium | Medium | Only 4 salespeople + strong CEO mandate; low change management burden |
| **System fragmentation (Access + NetSuite) limits integration** | Medium | High | Phase 1 designed as standalone; deeper integration deferred to post-ERP upgrade |
| **Competitive pricing spiral on base products** | High | Medium | AI model prevents below-floor pricing; specialty products provide margin insulation |
| **Revenue decline continues despite pricing improvements** | High | Medium | Capacity utilization strategy partially de-risks by targeting volume, not just margin |
| **Implementation delays from ERP upgrade dependency** | Low | Medium | Phase 1 is ERP-independent; Phases 2–3 can operate in parallel with ERP modernization |

## Data Enrichment Potential

| Category | Enrichment Opportunity |
|---|---|
| **Compound cost per pound by product line** (actual vs. quoted) | Would quantify exact cost pass-through gap and margin erosion by product |
| **Quote-to-close conversion rates by salesperson** | Would reveal whether pricing inconsistency is causing lost deals |
| **Product-level profitability (including labor allocation)** | Material margin data exists, but fully-loaded product margins are needed |
| **Customer-level margin analysis** | Would identify high-value vs. margin-destructive customer relationships |
| **Competitor pricing benchmarks** (e.g., Corveil Industrial, Netherby Elastomers, Brookline Tube) | Would validate floor-price assumptions |
| **Detailed backlog composition** ($14.9M+ stated backlog by product/margin) | Would inform capacity utilization strategy and pricing priorities |
